observations: Photo 0 shows a small, white, rectangular device with pink trim and a cartoon face (eyes, nose, mouth) on the front. It has a paper exit slot at the bottom. A hand is holding it, suggesting its small size. The device appears to be a thermal printer with a cute design.

Photo 1 shows the product packaging labeled 'Portable Mini Printer' with a printer icon and the phrase 'BD instant printing'. Four rolls of thermal paper are visible next to the box, still in plastic wrapping.
No brand or model name is visible on the device or packaging in either photo.
The device is not shown powered on or printing, and no cables, power adapter, or Bluetooth/WiFi indicators are visible.

risks.risk: The printer may be non-functional or defective.

Photo or video showing the printer's interface or settings screen to confirm wireless connectivity.
Close-up of the thermal paper rolls showing brand and specifications.
